comparisons.reason: Same verbatim-quote-of-OP construct. Pending difference: an empty comment list gives 0 in 0 but null in 1. Also, 0 gives null only when both title and argument are missing, while 1 gives null when title/argument is missing so matching can't be assessed.
2 also counts specific non-quoted references to identifiable OP elements ('you said X', 'your second paragraph'), which is broader than quotation only. Null rules also differ.
Same quote-of-OP construct. Pending difference: an empty comment list gives 0 in 0 but null in 3. Other rules agree: both-missing gives null, and later edits are matched against the current text.
2 includes specific references to OP text without quotation, which is broader than the direct quotation in 1.

Same quote construct, and an empty list gives null in both. Pending difference: 1 gives null when title or argument is missing (wording suggests either), while 3 gives null only when both are missing. This needs an explicit decision.
2 counts quotes plus specific non-quoted references to identifiable OP elements, while 3 counts direct quotations only. These are different constructs.
